info.title: Contract
info.description: Contracts help you organize your desk commitments, enabling you to deliver more professional and dedicated customer service. By defining contracts, you can determine the level of service to offer and set the contract period for an account or a product.

post.description: Updates multiple contracts at once by applying a field value change to the specified contract IDs.

get.description: Retrieves a list of contracts in the help desk portal, with pagination support.

parameters.name: viewId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the view to apply while fetching the contracts.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Criteria JSON to filter contracts based on field conditions. A maximum of 25 fields can be mentioned in the criteria JSON. The criteria JSON must be converted into an encoded string when sending it to the endpoint.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the saved filter to filter the records.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the account associated with the contract.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional information to include in the response. Possible values: accounts.

parameters.name: ownerIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the owner(s) from which the contracts must be fetched. Supports a maximum of 10 owner IDs, each separated by a comma.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of contracts to fetch

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which contracts must be fetched

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts contracts by the specified attribute. Possible values: accountName, contractName, contractEndDate, contractStartDate, createdTime, modifiedTime. Default sorting order is ascending. Prefix with '-' for descending.

parameters.name: contractName
parameters.description: Fetches contracts whose name starts with the provided string.

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the department(s) from which the contracts must be fetched. Supports a maximum of 10 department IDs, each separated by a comma.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: API names of the fields to fetch. All field types are supported except for multi-text. Standard, non-editable fields are also supported. Maximum of 30 fields supported as comma-separated values.
